label: CKD review: Review an atenolol regimen exceeding the renal dosing schedule or Cardol sotalol at CrCl below 10 mL/min
title: Review an atenolol regimen exceeding the renal dosing schedule or Cardol sotalol at CrCl below 10 mL/min
statement: For an adult outpatient with established CKD, review an atenolol regimen exceeding the renal dosing schedule or Cardol sotalol at CrCl below 10 mL/min.

plain_summary: For an adult outpatient with established CKD, review an atenolol regimen exceeding the renal dosing schedule or Cardol sotalol at CrCl below 10 mL/min. Current Cardol use with confirmed CrCl below 10 mL/min is contraindicated and needs same-day review.

medicine_groups.name: Oral atenolol
medicine_groups.note: Count oral atenolol only. Multiply tablet strength by tablets per dose and read the interval from the directions. Compare both the single dose and interval with the renal schedules. An average daily dose alone cannot establish that an unlisted schedule is equivalent. Ask the pharmacist to review a schedule that cannot be compared directly.

medicine_groups.name: Cardol oral sotalol
medicine_groups.note: Only a supply identified as Cardol starts this product-specific check. Solavert, Sotab, Sotahexal, Sotacor and a sotalol ingredient alone do not identify Cardol. If the brand is uncertain, check the pack or dispensing record before applying the Cardol threshold.

rule_for_models: For an adult outpatient with established CKD, check oral atenolol and named Cardol separately. For atenolol off dialysis, use stable indexed CrCl in mL/min/1.73 m²: at 15 to 35 inclusive compare with 50 mg daily or 100 mg every two days, and below 15 compare with 50 mg every two days or 100 mg every four days. Flag excess dose or frequency established from the strength and directions. Report none above 35 or within the applicable schedule. On haemodialysis compare with 50 mg orally after each session under hospital supervision. Flag a higher dose or documented extra doses between sessions. If modality, session timing or a nonstandard regimen prevents comparison, seek renal-team clarification as a possible finding. Do not infer an excess from a daily average alone. For Cardol, flag any supply at stable unindexed CrCl below 10 mL/min and report none at 10 or above. Dialysis status does not determine the Cardol branch. Cite the supply and relevant clinical evidence. Report no finding for a known exclusion. Otherwise name any missing eligibility, dose or renal evidence that could change the outcome and report only a possible finding.
cannot_be_seen: Dispensing does not establish the dose taken. Kidney results obtained elsewhere, their units and their timing may be missing.
ask_the_gp: Could you review the atenolol dose and timing against the patient's dialysis schedule or indexed creatinine clearance, or review Cardol against the unindexed clearance at supply?

needs_facts.meets: Established CKD at the time of outpatient supply.

options.words: CKD was established by the supply date
CKD was absent at the supply date
CKD is known now but its timing is unclear

needs_facts.meets: For oral atenolol off dialysis use stable indexed CrCl in mL/min/1.73 m² applicable on the supply date. Verify the date of a typed result. Indexed eGFR is a different measure.

needs_facts.what: Dialysis and atenolol schedule at supply
needs_facts.meets: Haemodialysis selects the post-session atenolol schedule. Off dialysis selects the indexed CrCl schedule. Peritoneal dialysis or unclear modality needs renal-team clarification if the schedule could be excessive. This answer does not determine the Cardol finding.

options.words: Haemodialysis with more than 50 mg after a session or extra doses between sessions
Haemodialysis with doses within the post-session schedule
Haemodialysis with dose or session timing still unclear
Off dialysis, assess the indexed clearance and regimen
Peritoneal dialysis, check the applicable regimen

needs_facts.meets: For a named Cardol supply, use stable unindexed CrCl below 10 mL/min applicable at supply. Verify the date of an undated typed value before confirming the band.
